title: connectors: os validate and the save door warn on a credential-shaped literal in a connector header or env map (#28640 ruling 1A)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

carries item ①A of #28640; #28640 keeps items ②B (the spec slice) and ③A (the export marker, filed beside this card).

Ruling-ref: 6566912252 (director record, batch #451 item 1, letters ①A·②B·③A, the maintainer's 「同意」). Filing gate: executing a recorded ruling. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage routes it; the ruling's Execution line names `domain:server` for this slice.

## What the ruling binds (①A, quoted from 6566912252)

"**①A — advisory, not refusal.** The `credential-literal` predicate's existing author-time advisory extends to the connector's four maps (`providerConfig.headers`, `defaultHeaders`, `transport.headers`, `transport.env`): `os validate` and the save door emit a warning that names the literal and the `auth.credentialRef` route; nothing is refused. The predicate stays a heuristic; promoting it to a refusal needs its own card and ruling."

## Where (seat readings on `origin/main` at filing)

- `packages/lint/src/credential-literal.ts`: the heuristic predicate; its header says callers advise and never refuse.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-flow-credential-literals.ts`: its one caller today, the precedent for the new caller (PR #20698 built it and its doors).
- The connector's four maps are withheld whole on read since #28596; this card adds the author-time warning only.

## Wanted

- A connector lint rule calling the same predicate over the four maps, with an `os explain` entry, surfaced by `os validate` and the save door as a warning naming the literal and the `auth.credentialRef` route.
- Tests: a `Bearer …` literal in each map warns; a non-credential header (`Accept: application/json`) does not; nothing is refused.

Workload (ruling): `domain:server`, one PR, about a day.
